name: 屋大维
description: 恺撒的养子和继承人。18岁，体弱多病但意志如钢。他尚在从希腊返回意大利的途中——没有军队，没有领土，只有恺撒的名字和阿格里帕的忠诚。但他很快就会证明：在罗马，名字比军团更值钱。
description_en: Caesar's adopted son and heir. 18 years old, sickly but iron-willed. He is still en route from Greece to Italy — no army, no territory, only Caesar's name and Agrippa's loyalty. But he will soon prove: in Rome, a name is worth more than legions.

name: 马克·安东尼
description: 恺撒最信任的副将，现任执政官。控制了罗马城和恺撒的国库，但布鲁图斯和卡西乌斯刚刚逃往东方——共和国的裂痕远未愈合。战场上的猛将，但政治上的冲动让他四面树敌。他必须在安抚元老院、拉拢老兵和维持权力之间找到一个不可能的平衡。
description_en: Caesar's most trusted lieutenant and current consul. He controls Rome and Caesar's treasury, but Brutus and Cassius have just fled east — the Republic's wounds are far from healed. A lion on the battlefield, but political impetuosity makes enemies of allies. He must find an impossible balance between appeasing the Senate, courting veterans, and maintaining power.

name: 克利奥帕特拉七世
description: 埃及最后一位伟大的法老。拥有地中海世界最富庶的粮仓和最古老王国的正统。会说九种语言，比她的罗马对手们更聪明——但她需要一位罗马盟友来保护埃及的独立。或者，她可以自己选择胜利者。
description_en: Egypt's last great Pharaoh. Controls the Mediterranean's richest granary and the legitimacy of the oldest kingdom. Speaks nine languages, smarter than her Roman rivals — but she needs a Roman ally to protect Egypt's independence. Or she can pick the winner herself.

name: 罗马元老院
description: 以西塞罗为首的共和派元老。共和国的最后守护者。他们没有军团，但有罗马城的钱袋、民众的舆论和五百年的传统。在这场巨人之间的战争中，话语可能是最锋利的武器。
description_en: The Republican faction led by Cicero. The last guardians of the Republic. They have no legions, but they have Rome's treasury, the people's voice, and five centuries of tradition. In this war of titans, words may be the sharpest weapon.

name: 塞克斯图斯·庞培
description: 庞培大帝之子。无寸土之地，但继承了父亲在地中海的舰队和旧部。反恺撒、反安东尼——对任何恺撒党人都心怀仇恨。控制着地中海西部的航线。
description_en: Son of Pompey the Great. No territory, but inherited his father's fleet and veteran network. Anti-Caesar, anti-Antony — bitter toward all Caesarians. Controls western Mediterranean shipping lanes.

name: 马尔库斯·雷必达
description: 恺撒的骑兵长官（Magister Equitum），西班牙总督。手握重兵但政治野心温和。忠于恺撒的记忆——自然倾向于安东尼。是恺撒派中的稳定力量，但也是各方争相拉拢的关键人物。
description_en: Caesar's Master of Horse, governor of Spain. Holds a strong army but modest political ambition. Loyal to Caesar's memory — naturally leans toward Antony. A stabilizing force among the Caesarians, but also a key swing figure courted by all sides.

name: 狄奇穆斯·布鲁图
description: 恺撒的刺杀者之一。现任山南高卢总督，手握3个军团。忠于共和制——与西塞罗的元老院天然同盟。占据北意大利，切断了安东尼与高卢军团之间的联系。
description_en: One of Caesar's assassins. Governor of Cisalpine Gaul with 3 legions. Loyal to the Republic — natural ally of Cicero's Senate. Holds northern Italy, cutting Antony's link to his Gallic legions.

name: 卡西乌斯与布鲁图斯
description: 刺杀恺撒的主导者。卡西乌斯已前往叙利亚接收军团，布鲁图斯在马其顿聚集共和派力量。他们是元老院在东方的武装臂膀——理想主义的共和派，手握东方行省的兵权。
description_en: The lead assassins of Caesar. Cassius has gone to Syria to take command of the legions there; Brutus is rallying Republican forces in Macedonia. They are the Senate's armed wing in the East — idealistic Republicans with real military power.
